- Report to the (Senior) International Tax Manager and assist in the control of personal income tax compliance tasks (e.g. application for Special Tax Regimes, client queries around taxes, Employment-related tax tasks, equity, etc.) for all of Remote’s clients worldwide

- Support the team in payroll tax audits and inspections worldwide.
- Monitor changes in tax law in several jurisdictions (EMEA, APAC, North America, Central and South America).
